name: Telnet service exposed
description: Telnet sends credentials and data without encryption.
evidence_required: Scanner reports 23/tcp open with service telnet
cannot_prove: That credentials are weak or the service is exploitable
recommendation: Disable Telnet and use SSH with key-based authentication.

name: FTP service exposed
description: FTP commonly transmits credentials without encryption.
evidence_required: Scanner reports 21/tcp open with service ftp
cannot_prove: That anonymous login is enabled or that data is exposed
recommendation: Replace FTP with SFTP or FTPS, or restrict access.

name: HTTP service without observed HTTPS
description: Unencrypted web traffic may expose data in transit.
evidence_required: Scanner reports 80/tcp open with service http
cannot_prove: That sensitive data is actually transmitted over HTTP
recommendation: Verify whether HTTP is required; redirect to HTTPS where possible.

name: SMB service exposed
description: SMB file sharing is reachable on the network.
cannot_prove: That the SMB version is vulnerable or that shares are open
recommendation: Restrict SMB to required hosts and confirm systems are patched.

name: RDP service exposed
description: Remote Desktop is reachable on the network.
cannot_prove: That authentication is weak or the host is compromised
recommendation: Restrict RDP access, require strong authentication, avoid direct exposure.

name: SSH service detected
description: SSH is an encrypted remote-access service.
evidence_required: Scanner reports 22/tcp open with service ssh
cannot_prove: That the SSH configuration is secure or insecure
recommendation: Confirm SSH is required and limit access to authorized users.

name: Database service port exposed
description: A database port is reachable from the scanned network position.
evidence_required: Scanner reports a common database port open
cannot_prove: That the database is unauthenticated or contains sensitive data
recommendation: Restrict database access to application hosts only; use firewall rules.

name: Legacy r-service exposed (rexec/rlogin/rsh)
description: Legacy remote-shell services use weak or no encryption.
cannot_prove: That the service accepts trusted-host logins or is exploitable
recommendation: Disable legacy r-services and use SSH instead.

name: Service on unexpected port
description: A known service type was seen on a non-standard port.
evidence_required: Scanner identifies a known service on a non-standard port
cannot_prove: That the placement is unauthorized or malicious
recommendation: Confirm with the system owner that this service and port are intended.

name: Service version banner detected
description: A version string was observed; patch status cannot be judged from the scan alone.
evidence_required: Scanner reports a service version string
cannot_prove: That the version is outdated or vulnerable
recommendation: Compare the version with vendor advisories and confirm patch level manually.
